#!/bin/bash
#For the beam elements
valu c 1.
valu h 0.1
valu dy 0.3
valu nd 0.05

pnt p1 -0.05 0 0
pnt p2  0.05 0 0
line l1 p1 p2 1
seta fix1 all
swep fix1 fix1 tra 0 1 0 1
seta fix1 all
comp fix1 do

swep all wing tra 0 0 1
seta surface s A002 A003 A004
comp surface do
#
#
seta length l L00A L00B L008 L009
seta width l L002 L003 L006 L007
#
div length auto nd
div width auto nd
elty all he8
mesh all
#


send all abq
send fix1 abq nam
send surface abq nam

view surface
# #rot z
#rot r 50
#rot u 50

plot f all

sys mv surface.nam interface_beam.nam
sys mv fix1.nam fix1_beam.nam

# Add thing here for the boundary condition
# sys echo
# quit

# plus pa all
